title: Remove 217 Progress strategies from service before history cleanup
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: А что такое /D:/CodexTemp/runs/manual-b2045dd89ca74e9897fa9b582870e169/artifacts/deploy-progress217 и зачем его надо выкладывать? Раньше ты прекрасно удалял стратегии и их историю сам. У тебя же есть доступ к базе сервера
Ок, скорректируй сервис и я его перевыложу. Потом очистим историю.

scope.goal: Prepare a normal service source release that removes the exact previously approved 217 unreferenced negative-Gross Progress variants from runnable catalog and seed paths without deleting or rewriting their existing local or product database rows or history; database history cleanup happens only after the user deploys this release and is verified separately.
inScope: Use the exact immutable 217 UUID/code target set approved by RC-20260819-remove-217-unreferenced-negative-progress-strategies at sha256:f5f2af6d514277bfeacdc14c70e6efdcceb50173a240aeb538160149791ff0ac; do not recalculate Gross PnL or target membership.
Exclude exactly those 217 variants from the runtime StrategyIds registries, static PostgreSQL strategy seeds, dynamic LowerEnter generation, and every service startup reseed path.

Preserve the three referenced source strategies b7c50005-0000-4000-8166-000000000003, b7c50005-0000-4000-8172-000000000004, and b7c50005-0000-4000-8172-000000000005 and their three retained LowerEnter owners with prefix b7c50005-0001 and matching group/suffix.
Preserve shared Progress processor algorithms and every retained strategy behavior and reference.

Remove the automatic target-history cleanup transaction from this service release. Starting or initializing this build must not delete or update an existing target strategy row or any target-owned Paper, Live, run, position, settlement, relationship, projection, audit, tombstone, rollup, event, queue, or other history row as a consequence of this change.

Keep the existing 217 target database rows stopped until the later cleanup: enabled=false, live_stakes=false, paused=true with no pause expiry. This release does not re-enable or otherwise rewrite them.
Build and test the corrected service, then hand it off through the user's normal deployment workflow rather than requiring the temporary D:\CodexTemp publish folder as the deployment interface.
Commit the verified correction on the normal source branch and hand that exact commit to the user for the normal brief deployment restart.
Treat post-deployment read-only verification and local/product history cleanup as the next separate operational tasks; neither is claimed as completed evidence for this source-release commit.
outOfScope: Deleting, truncating, archiving, compacting, migrating, or otherwise mutating existing target strategy rows or target history in either local or product PostgreSQL during this service-correction task.
Executing the previously prepared automatic cleanup migration during deployment of this release.
Changing the exact 217 target set, adding local-only negatives, recalculating PnL, or deleting the three referenced sources or their retained owners.
Removing shared Progress algorithms still used by retained strategies or changing any retained trading behavior.
Creating a database backup, dump, archive, or restore point.
Stopping the service as a maintenance state, stopping unrelated strategies, cancelling orders, or changing Live/Paper mode; the user's normal brief deployment restart remains allowed.
Vacuuming, shrinking, compacting, or otherwise reclaiming physical database space.
Post-deployment runtime verification and the later local/product history-deletion transaction; they begin only after this source release is committed and the user deploys it.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact fixed 217 UUID/code set from the previously approved 220 product-negative Progress set minus the same three referenced source strategies; no database-history period is selected because history mutation is deferred.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the current service catalog, all static/dynamic seed paths, and the prepared automatic cleanup block/tests to separate catalog retirement from database deletion without changing the exact 217 set or retained references.

requirements.text: Correct the service so exactly the approved 217 strategies cannot be seeded, resolved, or dispatched after deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact 217 UUID/code variants are absent from the effective runtime registry and every static or dynamic seed output.
A startup against an empty strategy catalog does not create any of the 217 targets.
A startup against a database that still contains the stopped target rows does not make those rows runnable and does not create any new catalog alias for them.
The three referenced source strategies and their three retained LowerEnter owners remain present with their exact original reference fields.
No retained descriptor references a removed catalog target, and shared Progress behavior remains available to retained variants.

verification.command: Run focused exact catalog, seed, retained-reference, Child Progress, and processor catalog tests.
verification.expected: Exactly 217 targets are absent from runtime/seed outputs; the three sources, three owners, and all retained references/behaviors remain correct.

verification.command: Build PolyCopyTrader.sln in Release with all temporary output under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Solution build completes with zero errors.
verification.evidence: Release solution build completed with 0 errors and 126 existing warnings; log: D:\CodexTemp\runs\manual-b2045dd89ca74e9897fa9b582870e169\logs\staged-catalog-solution.log.

requirements.text: Do not clean or rewrite target database history during this service deployment; history cleanup happens afterward.
acceptanceCriteria: The service source contains no enabled startup migration or dispatch path that deletes the 217 target strategy rows or any target-owned structured history.

Running schema initialization twice over a fixture containing stopped target rows and representative Paper, Live, run, position, settlement, relationship, projection, audit, v1/v2 archive, rollup, event, and queue history preserves exact target row identities, counts, and payload fingerprints.
The correction does not update target control fields, timestamps, reference fields, or history payloads.
Documentation clearly states that this release only retires catalog/seed logic and that database deletion is a separate later step.
No local or product database DML is executed as part of implementing or testing this correction outside an isolated disposable PostgreSQL fixture.

verification.command: Run a focused isolated PostgreSQL initializer test with existing stopped target rows and representative target history, capture exact rows/counts/fingerprints before initialization, initialize twice, and compare afterward.
verification.expected: Every target database row and history fingerprint is unchanged; no cleanup marker or deletion side effect is created.
verification.evidence: Fresh isolated PostgreSQL run passed 6/6 in D:\CodexTemp\runs\manual-b2045dd89ca74e9897fa9b582870e169\results\staged-catalog-pg-2\staged-catalog-pg-2.trx; the double-initializer fixture preserved exact target/history count and MD5 and created no cleanup marker.

verification.command: Inspect the final PostgresSchema diff and search all startup SQL for the 217 cleanup key, target DELETE statements, and automatic cleanup dispatch.
verification.expected: No automatic 217-target cleanup remains in this service release; only catalog/seed exclusion remains.
verification.evidence: Final source inspection found the superseded cleanup key only in negative assertions/marker-count test queries; PostgresSchema contains no automatic 217-target cleanup dispatch or DELETE block. git diff --check passed with line-ending notices only.

requirements.text: Commit and hand off a normal source release for the user to redeploy before any later history cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: The corrected changes are available through the repository's normal branch/commit workflow; the temporary D:\CodexTemp publish directory is not required as the user-facing deployment mechanism.
The deployment handoff identifies the exact commit and requires only the user's normal brief restart, not a deliberate maintenance stop.
The implementation commit contains no local/product database mutation and no automatic history cleanup.
The handoff states that post-deployment read-only verification is the immediate next task and that history cleanup cannot begin before that verification passes.

verification.command: Validate the staged requirement contract and exact source diff, commit the verified implementation on codex/progress-purge-217, and record the commit identity and upstream state.
verification.expected: A normal Git source commit contains the exact verified correction, has no automatic cleanup path, and is ready for the user's deployment; post-deployment verification remains explicitly next.
